about: We ask that the sacraments we have received may guard God’s faithful people and defend them against every hostile attack. Peter Martyr’s intercession accompanies the petition.

seg.tr: Lord, may the sacraments we have received guard Your faithful people and, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr, protect them against all hostile attacks. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: may the sacraments we have received guard
through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr
protect them against all hostile attacks
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w001: The Lord’s faithful people are guarded by the sacraments, not the other way around. They are named first for emphasis.
ex.w011: Peter here is Peter Martyr, not Peter the Apostle.
ex.w035: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
